content.short: Infinex is a non-custodial trading platform featuring a CEX-like interface and seamless chain abstraction.
content.description: Infinex is an innovative decentralized trading platform designed to bridge the usability gap between centralized exchanges and DeFi. Founded by the creators of Synthetix, it utilizes chain abstraction to provide a 'CEX-like' user experience, eliminating the complexities of manual bridging and gas fee management. Through its secure, non-custodial architecture, Infinex allows users to trade assets across multiple networks with speed and simplicity. Powered by the INX token, the platform focuses on mass adoption by making decentralized trading intuitive and highly accessible.
content.meta: Infinex provides a non-custodial trading experience with chain abstraction. Discover Infinex and other DeFi Dapps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
